title: Filter rows
summary: A condition creates a true-or-false value for each row. Use that condition to keep matching rows.
introduction: A condition creates a true-or-false value for each row. Use that condition to keep matching rows. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A condition creates a true-or-false value for each row. Use that condition to keep matching rows.

blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Asha", "Ben", "Cara"],
    "score": [8, 6, 9],
    "team": ["red", "blue", "red"]
})

passed = df[df["score"] >= 8]
print(passed["name"].tolist())
blocks.title: Filter rows

blocks.text: The output is ['Asha', 'Cara']. Their scores meet the chosen threshold.
